headlines.title: 주택가격전망 CSI, 4년 10개월 만 최고치
headlines.summary: [서울=뉴시스] 최동준 기자 = 집값 오름세가 지속되면서 주택가격전망지수(CSI)가 4년 10개월 만에 최고 수준으로 상승했다. 28일 한국은행이 발표한 '7월 소비자동향조사'에 따르면 소비자심리지수(CCSI)는 전월(106.6)보다 0.2포인트 오른 106.8이다. 주택가격전망CSI는 전월(120)보다 7포인트 상승한 127이다.

key_headlines.title: Capital Gains Tax Reform Targets 1 Billion Won Ceiling on Long-Term Ownership Deduction
key_headlines.summary: The government is preparing comprehensive real estate tax reforms that will limit capital gains tax deductions for long-term homeowners to a maximum of 1 billion won, while maintaining up to 80% deduction rates based on residency duration. Experts debate whether the monetary cap is excessive and predict potential increased property sales from elderly homeowners.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse Crisis Spreads Beyond Apartments to Villas and Multi-Family Homes
key_headlines.summary: The jeonse (long-term lease deposit) shortage originating in the apartment market has expanded to non-apartment sectors including villas, where renewal contract acceptance rates dropped to 36% and prices are rising. The government is actively pursuing short-term supply measures through multi-family housing utilization to address the broader housing crisis.

key_headlines.title: Korean Stock Market Experiences Black Tuesday with Circuit Breaker Triggers on Both KOSPI and KOSDAQ
key_headlines.summary: Domestic stock markets experienced severe declines triggering automatic trading halts (circuit breakers) on both KOSPI and KOSDAQ indices due to negative sentiment from US tech stock selloffs and semiconductor sector weakness. The broad market downturn reflects international economic uncertainty and semiconductor industry concerns.

key_headlines.title: Reverse Trading Surges 596% in Six Months as Elderly Investors Face Forced Liquidation
key_headlines.summary: Reverse trading (forced liquidation) transactions soared from 56.5 billion won in January to 393.5 billion won in June, with investors aged 70 and above experiencing a 791% increase in forced closures. The first half of 2026 saw approximately 1 trillion won in forced liquidation settlements as equity market volatility impacts leveraged retail investors.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Faces Pressure to Cut Rates Despite Inflation Concerns Ahead of FOMC Decision
key_headlines.summary: President Trump is pressuring the Federal Reserve to lower interest rates, arguing US GDP growth could reach 8-12% with lower rates, claiming America should have the world's lowest rates. The FOMC meeting scheduled for July 28-29 is expected to hold rates steady despite political pressure and international oil price volatility.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government is implementing comprehensive real estate tax reforms focusing on owner-occupied housing, including limiting capital gains tax deductions to 1 billion won for multi-property owners while temporarily easing their exit burden through tax incentives. The jeonse crisis that began in apartments is spreading to villas and multi-family homes, with renewal contract acceptance rates dropping significantly and prices rising sharply. Additionally, the government is actively pursuing short-term supply measures through converting vacant commercial and office spaces to meet urgent housing demand.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Consumer housing price expectations reached their highest level in 4 years and 10 months at an index of 127, driven by continued Seoul and Gyeonggi apartment price increases, while consumer sentiment improved for three consecutive months. The game and content industries contribute 60% of export trade balance but receive only 7% of government budget allocations, with experts calling for annual 10% budget increases. Indonesia's President Prabowo's approval rating collapsed from 81% to 51% in eight months amid economic deterioration, while the country maintains fiscal deficit targets of less than 3% of GDP.
sections.Financial Markets: The domestic stock market experienced severe declines on July 28-29, triggering multiple circuit breakers on both KOSPI and KOSDAQ as semiconductor and technology stocks plummeted following US market losses. Reverse trading (forced liquidation) transactions surged 596% in six months from 56.5 billion won in January to 393.5 billion won in June, with investors aged 70 and older experiencing 791% increase in forced closures. Low PBR (Price-to-Book Ratio) companies faced trading restrictions, while the market showed signs of significant volatility driven by both domestic and international factors.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung launched the Galaxy Z8 series foldable phones on pre-order starting July 28, featuring a 15% larger battery capacity while reducing thickness by 10% through new 'Flex Titanium' display technology and silicon carbon materials. South Korea and Brazil agreed to establish working groups for negotiating Mercosur trade agreement resumption targeted for December, with seven technology cooperation fields including bioeconomy, sustainable fuels, AI, semiconductors, automobiles, shipbuilding, and batteries. Tokyo Electron Korea opened a 'Semiconductor Dream Lab' at Kidzania where children can experience semiconductor manufacturing processes, while the TIGER US Philadelphia Semiconductor NASDAQ ETF achieved record 6 trillion won in net assets as the largest overseas thematic ETF in Korea.
sections.Real Estate: Consumer home price expectations reached their highest point in 4 years and 10 months as Seoul and Gyeonggi region apartment prices continued rising, with the consumer sentiment index at 106.8. The jeonse crisis expanded beyond apartments to villas and multi-family homes, where renewal rates dropped to 36% and prices surged dramatically with some properties showing double-pricing. Real estate transaction and supply markets are expected to contract due to rising interest rates and tightened bank lending, as borrowers unable to access traditional financing are being pushed toward higher-cost second-tier financial products.
sections.International Economy: President Trump repeatedly pressured the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates before the FOMC meeting, arguing US GDP growth could reach 8-12% with lower rates and claiming America should maintain the world's lowest rates like 30 years ago. The US Trade Representative stated that Section 301 tariffs would not influence Federal Reserve rate decisions, though the FOMC meeting scheduled for July 28-29 is expected to maintain rates amid international oil price volatility from US-Iran tensions. Brazil filed a WTO complaint against US tariffs ranging from 25-37.5% on Brazilian products, creating ongoing bilateral trade friction affecting diplomatic relations.
sections.AI & Economy: AI-related power demand is surging but infrastructure expansion faces delays, with 20 of 54 planned transmission network projects experiencing schedule setbacks as the government pushes AI edge data center development. Residential opposition has emerged against AI data center construction projects in Seoul's Yongsan district due to concerns about power supply stability and neighborhood impacts, despite their relatively small scale of basement 4 floors to above-ground 5 floors.
sections.Others: The government is restructuring education tax allocation, planning to shift approximately 1 trillion won from basic education to early childhood and higher education starting in the 2027 budget cycle. South Korea's manufacturing sector has become increasingly concentrated in the Seoul metropolitan area over the past decade, with semiconductor export boom driving major production facilities of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to concentrate in Gyeonggi Province. Financial Services Commission Chair Lee Eok-won warned of implementing additional measures including individual investment limits of 20% for leveraged ETFs on single stocks if demand for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix leveraged products fails to stabilize. North Korea's foreign trade reached 3.1 billion dollars in 2025, approaching pre-COVID levels, with Chinese trade accounting for the absolute majority at 3.07 billion dollars in bilateral exchange.
